name: Caliburn
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Caliburn is a name for Excalibur. Excalibur is the magic sword of King Arthur. Other forms of the name are Carliburnus, Caladfwlch, and Caedvwlch.

okr.objective: A name for the magic sword of Arthur
key_results: Caliburn is another name for Excalibur.
Excalibur is the magic sword of Arthur.
